title: Brazilian Chicken Bake
description: A Brazilian-inspired Italian dish featuring chicken, rice, and a hint of grassy flavor.
instructions: Rinse and season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and bake seasoning.
In a large skillet, heat the grassy olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the rice according to package instructions.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with the cooked rice and garnish with additional grassy olive oil if desired.
